name: Monport UV Pro
tagline: UV galvo for 3D engraving inside crystal and glass: 6W or 10W, chiller included
tldr: Monport's UV Pro, listed in September 2026, is a 355 nm UV galvo built for 3D engraving inside crystal and glass, with a 70 × 70 mm 3D lens, an electric Z lift and a separate water chiller in the package. Two sources: 6W ($3,190, 10,000 mm/s, in stock) and 10W ($4,990, 15,000 mm/s, shipping in early November 2026). Open a tier for exact specs.
mainObjective: 3D crystal engraving and clean UV marking on glass and plastics

priceRange.note: Official Monport store, Oct 2026: 6W $3,190, 10W $4,990 (shipping early November), water chiller included; the LightBurn bundle adds $200

engraveExample.description: 3D photo engraved inside a K9 crystal block

Water chiller included on both tiers
355 nm cold marking: clean, unburned marks on plastics, glass and heat-sensitive parts

faq.question: What is the difference between the UV Pro and Monport's 2D UV engraver?
faq.answer: The UV Pro carries the hardware for 3D inner engraving. Monport sells a 2D-only UV galvo separately ($2,719.99 for 6W and $4,369.99 for 10W in October 2026) and a $700 kit that converts its 10W 2D model to 3D. If you only mark surfaces or flat designs inside glass, the 2D model costs less.

faq.question: Which UV Pro tier should I choose?
faq.answer: The 6W ($3,190) for gifts and small runs; the 10W ($4,990, shipping early November 2026) when 3D crystals or UV marking are a daily production job, since it scans at 15,000 mm/s instead of 10,000 mm/s.

standoutFeatures.title: Built for 3D crystals
standoutFeatures.body: A 70 × 70 mm lens, electric Z lift and SapphireMark's 3D file support (STL, OBJ, GLB) target photo crystals and engraved glass blocks.

standoutFeatures.title: Chiller in the package
standoutFeatures.body: Both tiers ship with a separate water chiller, which keeps the UV source stable during long jobs.

beginnerNotes: This overview covers the whole UV Pro line. Choose the 6W to start with 3D photo crystals and fine marking; choose the 10W for production volumes.
proTips: Keep the chiller topped up and wear the supplied OD5 glasses: the UV beam is invisible and the galvo is open.
primaryUse: UV galvo for 3D crystal engraving and fine marking on glass and plastics.

editorialDepth.advantages: The UV Pro packages what 3D crystal engraving needs, lens, Z lift, chiller and software, at a price that compares well with enclosed UV machines that need extras for the same work.
editorialDepth.limitations: It is an open Class 4 galvo with manual focus and no camera, SapphireMark is Windows-only, and the specs are Monport's until independent reviews appear.
